samples.sample_label: Australian listed companies audit fee regressions (1990, 1992, 1994, 1998)
samples.sample_unit_detail: Listed Australian public company in a given snapshot year
samples.period_detail: Four separate cross-sectional samples, not a single pooled panel.

primary_collection: Annual report audit fee and financial data collected by authors from listed company disclosures.

sample_size.quote:
We collected data for
1,174 companies in 1990, 965 companies in 1992, 1,069 in 1994, and 1,084 in
1998 using Huntleys Datanalysis

sample_unit.quote:
We collected data for
1,174 companies in 1990, 965 companies in 1992, 1,069 in 1994, and 1,084 in
1998

sample_period.quote:
We selected four years: 1990, 1992, and 1994, following the 1989 mergers in the Big
8 group, and 1998 following the 1997 merger in the Big 6 group.

data_sources.quote:
Huntleys Datanalysis, Huntleys Datanalysis (Delisted Companies), the
Australian Stock Exchange Library, the Australian Stock Exchange Microfiche
Collection in the State Library of NSW, Connect 4, and Reuters Beacon.

missing_fields.sample_size: Baseline audit-fee tests use separate cross-sections each year rather than one designated pooled N.

review_notes: Principal tests are Simunic-style audit fee regressions estimated separately for each snapshot year.

data_section_full_text:
We collected data for
1,174 companies in 1990, 965 companies in 1992, 1,069 in 1994, and 1,084 in
1998 using Huntleys Datanalysis, Huntleys Datanalysis (Delisted Companies), the
Australian Stock Exchange Library, the Australian Stock Exchange Microfiche
Collection in the State Library of NSW, Connect 4, and Reuters Beacon.
review_notes: Four snapshot years each have distinct baseline Ns; no single pooled sample_size designated.
